description.en: Exaeretodon argentinus inspired living reconstruction: whole living environment prop. Nominal 1m envelope; no fossil metrology claim. APP2022 species cranial/dental text plus PVL2554 left humerus/femur and species Fig4 silhouette. Composite living reconstruction, not single specimen scan. Broad cheeks, blunt muzzle, low grinding basins, short robust limbs, heavy low trunk and tapered short tail. Soft tissues, teeth count, color, feet and pose artistic.
